**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/07/30 (Sun) 15:46
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The evaluation will use a mixed-methods approach to collect both quantitative and qualitative data.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Participants will be provided with a physical activity tracking device to wear for one week before and one week after the festival.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The data collected will include daily step count, duration of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity, and sedentary behavior.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Participants will complete an online survey before and after the festival, including questions about their physical activity levels, attitudes towards physical activity, perceived barriers to physical activity, and demographic information.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The number of people who attend the festival will be recorded by festival organizers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Two focus groups will be conducted with participants, one during the festival and one after the festival, which will be audio recorded and transcribed.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Semi-structured interviews will be conducted with festival organizers and community stakeholders, which will also be audio recorded and transcribed.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Feedback forms will be provided to participants at the end of the festival, which will be analyzed for common themes and suggestions for improvement.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The quantitative data will be analyzed using appropriate statistical methods, such as t-tests and ANOVA, to assess changes in physical activity levels and attitudes towards physical activity before and after the festival.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The statistical analyses will be conducted using software such as SPSS or SAS.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The qualitative data will be analyzed using a thematic analysis approach, identifying and refining common themes and patterns from transcripts and feedback forms.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The mixed-methods data will be integrated using a triangulation approach to compare and contrast results from quantitative and qualitative data.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The results of the evaluation will be presented in a final report, including recommendations for future festivals based on the findings.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for future festivals include holding the festival every 2-5 years to maintain interest and engagement in physical activity.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Future evaluations could use a control group to assess the impact of the festival on physical activity levels.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is recommended that a larger sample size be used in future evaluations to improve statistical power.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Future evaluations should include long-term follow-up to assess sustained impact on physical activity levels and attitudes.
